caveats_en: Coordinates are approximate. 129 records have no named venue and are pinned to central Dhaka (geoPrecision: city). A further 48 were resolved to a named venue's coordinates from the record's own sourced title/text, not from independent confirmation of the exact spot.
97 records give only a month, not a day. Those are stored as the first of the month with datePrecision: month.
87 records name a publication but have no article link (verified: false). They are not citations.
300 records is a count of recorded events, not a claim that exactly 300 separate movements took place.
This dataset has no casualty or crowd-size figures. Do not render zeroes as if they were measured.
